# Commit message guidelines

Header: `<type>(<scope>): <summary>`, at most 72 characters, imperative mood, lowercase, no trailing period.
The body explains **why**. Footers: `BREAKING CHANGE: <migration>`, `Fixes #<n>`.
Reverts: `revert: <original header>` with body `This reverts commit <SHA>.`

## Types

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `build` | Changes to the build system or dependencies |
| `ci` | Changes to CI configuration |
| `docs` | Documentation only |
| `feat` | A new feature |
| `fix` | A bug fix |
| `i18n` | Internationalisation: the code and tooling that make RKL translatable (not the translations) |
| `l10n` | Localisation: the translations themselves, usually Crowdin's pull requests |
| `perf` | A performance improvement |
| `refactor` | A change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature |
| `release` | Release commits |
| `test` | Adding or fixing tests |
